evaluation.strengths: Flexible hasty, vigilant trampler; dies into tapped Treasures. Smile returns it with X=0 but adds its counter before state-based actions, so it survives as a 1/1. Miles counters immediately improve both combat and death payout.
evaluation.failure_modes_and_costs: Small at low investment; death Treasures are tapped. Exile avoids payout. Nonlegendary/non-Spider, so Ultimate does not double its counters.
evaluation.priority: mythic-first review order; not a rarity-based strength ranking

source.name: Smile at Death
source.oracle_text: At the beginning of your upkeep, return up to two target creature cards with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Put a +1/+1 counter on each of those creatures.
source.flavor_text:
"Khan Alesha ensured our survival. Now we will forge our future."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

scope: Additional green/colorless creatures; no deck quantities, deck construction, playtest or popularity claims.
method: Cached public pool screened mythic then rare then uncommon. Selected cards live queried on Scryfall with game:arena, unique:prints; selected released printings require current Standard legal, arena in games, and non-null arena_id. Oracle source records retained.
rules_notes: Ordinary removal can stock Smile; no special self-mill requirement assumed.
Smile adds counters during the same resolution as return; state-based actions do not kill zero-toughness creatures between those instructions.
Graveyard power determines eligibility; ordinary battlefield counters do not carry into graveyard. Characteristic-defining power abilities would require separate assessment.
No mana feasibility simulation or assumption that generic artifact costs bypass restricted mana.
